card.name: Additive-effect wording in drug interactions
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction text where two drugs used together are said to add up, such as 'may', 'in' after 'result', or the middle of 'Central Nervous System' and 'amlodipine'. It appears mostly in anticholinergic and CNS depressant interaction sections.

modes.label: Linking verbs before additive effects
modes.description: Small words like 'may' or 'in' after 'concomitant use' or 'may result' that lead into an increased or additive effect.
